ResetAllFiles resets a File Storage to the initial state, containing only the files which were deployed from the Target Configuration, with their initial content. Afterwards, the File Storage will appear as if it was newly installed from the current Target Configuration. It will fail with kResourceBusy when the File Storage is currently open, or when it is modified by a call from another thread to UpdatePersistency, CleanUpPersistency, ResetPersistency, RecoverAllFiles, or ResetAllFiles.
